critical_code_review_comments: _get_topup_price_id reads STRIPE_PRICE_TOPUP_<PACK>.upper() from os.environ on every call — fine, but uppercasing the pack_id means env var keys must be UPPERCASE. Already the case in .env. OK.

TopupCheckoutPayload only validates `pack_id` is a string — pydantic. The 400 returns the raw pack_id verbatim in the error message ('Unknown top-up pack: <input>'). Low-risk XSS reflection in JSON error body — fine for API, but if the frontend ever renders this raw it should be escaped.

list_topup_packs response embeds `**v` from TOPUP_PACKS — exposes internal fields like duration_hours, letter_quota, contract_quota. Probably intentional for UI but worth a deliberate whitelist if any of those become sensitive in the future.

user_to_public computes `active_topup` using string comparison on ISO datetimes (line 464 `expires > now.isoformat()`). This works because both strings are timezone-aware UTC. Will silently break if a timezone-naive ISO string ever lands in topup_active. Add a defensive datetime.fromisoformat() compare instead.
